newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday rounup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Wednesday rounup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate to active in the panhandle area Wednesday, with most trade occuring after noon, USDA said. Slaughter steers $1.00 per cwt lower compared to last good test and heifers steady.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 34,500 slaughter steers and 21,400 heifers; 75,300 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,300 formulated and 700 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 68.00, pen Longhorns 65.50.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 68.00, several pens 950-1000 lbs 67.00. Pen Utility and Choice 2-4 1100 lbs, including heiferettes, 64.00.
Wk to Date - 75,300 Week Ago - 81,000 Year Ago - 26,400
